cases.title: 单实体属性直查
cases.sqlExpected: select "customer"."id" as "__identity", "customer"."email" as "property.customer.email", "customer"."tier" as "property.customer.tier" from "customer" where "customer"."id" = ? fetch next ? rows only

cases.title: 批量实体直查（缺失行同形）
cases.sqlExpected: select "customer"."id" as "__identity", "customer"."email" as "property.customer.email", "customer"."tier" as "property.customer.tier" from "customer" where "customer"."id" in (?, ?) fetch next ? rows only

cases.title: 布尔判定列（引用已发布 Rule，无内联表达式）
cases.sqlExpected: select "customer"."id" as "__identity", "customer"."tier" as "property.customer.tier", "customer"."id" in (select "orders"."customer_id" from "orders" group by "orders"."customer_id" having sum("orders"."amount") >= ?) as "metric.high_value_customer" from "customer" where "customer"."id" = ? fetch next ? rows only

cases.title: 口径变体命中（声明式条件进入 WHERE）
cases.sqlExpected: select sum("orders"."amount") as "value", "orders"."region" as "dim.region" from "orders" where ("orders"."channel" = ? and "orders"."order_date" >= cast(? as timestamp) and "orders"."order_date" <= cast(? as timestamp)) group by "orders"."region" fetch next ? rows only

cases.title: 多口径指标缺变体 → 澄清而非默认
上季度（tep.last_quarter，时间窗走绑定值）
cases.sqlExpected: select sum("orders"."amount") as "value", "orders"."region" as "dim.region" from "orders" where ("orders"."order_date" >= cast(? as timestamp) and "orders"."order_date" <= cast(? as timestamp)) group by "orders"."region" fetch next ? rows only
